code.method: Use unchanged v1 literal source fields, source guard, season regex and date parser for a stagewise quality audit

predeclared_counts: Deployment rows and admissible exact four-part joins
First-rejection stage for each detection row: missing join key, invalid season year, empty/unknown species, unmatched physical deployment key, invalid datetime, DST ambiguous, or candidate usable
Independent marginal rates for primary site key, season-year coding, species nonmissing, exact join and datetime parsing
Raw YearSeason category strings and counts ONLY (no camera IDs or species names or detection times)
DateTime textual FORMAT CLASS counts ONLY (e.g. slash date versus ISO, unclassified)
Distinct primary sites of structurally usable candidate events, if any
do_not_report: real animal taxa, any species label or frequency, any camera/site IDs or exact coordinates
date or time values, hour/bin/diel outcomes, ecological gain or fitted model coefficients
any replacement source dataset or posthoc scientific threshold
if_all_event_rows_rejected: Source v1 remains unavailable. The audit may motivate a separate EXPLORATORY descriptive source harmonization, but no version may retroactively claim confirmatory ecological transfer.
